intents.scenario: Verify that a University entity can be created with valid name and country
intents.acceptanceCriteria: Scenario 1 - Successful adding of the new university

intents.scenario: Verify that creating a University with null or empty name throws ArgumentException
intents.assertionCode:
var ex = Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new University("", "Costa Rica"));
Assert.That(ex.Message, Does.Contain("Name"));
intents.acceptanceCriteria: Scenario 2 - Prevent addition with incorrect property format

intents.scenario: Verify that creating a University with null or empty country throws ArgumentException
intents.assertionCode:
var ex = Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new University("Universidad de Costa Rica", ""));
Assert.That(ex.Message, Does.Contain("Country"));
intents.acceptanceCriteria: Scenario 2 - Prevent addition with incorrect property format
